title: India 'funds organisations behind terror activities in Pakistan': Bilawal Bhutto Zardari
summary: In an interview with FRANCE 24, Bilawal Bhutto Zardari, head of the Pakistan People's Party, discussed the ongoing tensions between India and Pakistan.
